# airlock_group_path (Resource)

Manage a trusted path entry on an Airlock policy group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "airlock_group_path" "example" {
  group_id = "1700000004"
  value    = "C:\\Program Files\\Example\\*"
  comment  = "Example trusted tooling path"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Airlock policy group ID.
- `value` (String) Path pattern.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable Terraform import ID for this Airlock relationship.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import airlock_group_path.example '1700000004:C:\Program Files\Example\*'
```
